polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. Covestro's ISO datasheet for Makrolon 2405 (R-COVESTRO-MAKROLON-2405-ISO), a general-purpose, low-viscosity polycarbonate, prints a density of 1200 kg/m³ (ISO 1183-1) and a water absorption of 0.30 % at saturation in water at 23 °C and 0.12 % at equilibrium at 23 °C / 50 % RH (ISO 62), p. 3. It prints no 24-hour figure. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives PC 1.14-1.21 Mg/m³.
